The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ab835f6a98c10d6d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let K = K′ × K′′ be a connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group with lattice Λ = Λ′ × Λ′′, and let π denote the first group projection and its induced map of nilmanifolds. Let H ⊆ K be a connected rational subgroup with a connected rational filtration H• satisfying (7.1). Let h ∈ K, and let σ ∈ K be rational. Let S be a fixed automorphism of K′ preserving Λ′. Suppose that, for every 1 ≤ q ≤ s + 1, applying S to the entries on any upper codimension-one face preserves setwise the projected cube coset π (︂ hdiag Cq (H•)σdiag Λ{0,1}q /Λ{0,1}q )︂ . (7.13) Then there is a polynomial shear T : h → h such that, for every u ∈ h, π (︁ h exp(Tu)σΛ )︁ = S (︁ π(h exp(u)σΛ) )︁ . (7.14) The lift is a bijection of the cover. Its action on the other component is unrestricted. This conclusion applies separately to every point coset from Proposition 7.4; no measurable choice of lifts as a function of β, r is required.
